construction.name: finite_rhombicuboctahedron_face_return
construction.coordinate_convention: Exact centers and vertices are twice native unit-edge coordinates. Canonical vertices are signed permutations of (1+sqrt(2),1,1); the support at a normal with k nonzero entries is k+sqrt(2).
construction.classical_start: (2+sqrt(2))*D3; integer words have even coordinate sum
construction.physical_operation: Select whole owners from the classical FCC lattice at a marked cell center, face, edge or vertex. Keep one actual directed face-separator for each pair and every host wall. Reconstruct all owner translations jointly. At each continued return, assign pair ports to realized separating faces before reconstructing the entire next configuration. Every owner remains whole and retains the canonical frame.
construction.native_clearance: From the exact ideal packing, dilate centers by1+1/500000 and take host scale=(1+1/500000)*exact_nominal+1/500000. Unit owners are retained.
construction.new_configuration: The realized finite geometry differs from its initial FCC window under every canonical signed-coordinate symmetry and common translation.
